name: Dome Exhibitions Dubai
headline: HOME-DOME EVENTS & EXHIBITIONS
lede: Dome has provided us with an unmatched quality and service for various exhibition and event projects that we have done in the middle east region.
about: Dome has provided us with an unmatched quality and service for various exhibition and event projects that we have done in the middle east region. With all services under one roof and a great team of professionals it’s ‘relaxing' working with them at various levels. We wish them all the success in their future endeavours.

We worked with Dome over a 9 month period for exhibition related matters including Exhibtions booths and layout design. Having worked in international events around the world for a number or years Dome are certainly one of the best we have worked with and if we return to UAE at any stage will definitely be using again.
